title: Freedom
coreMove: Measure money by how much control it buys over ordinary time.
sourcePressure: The highest return from money is autonomy: less coercion over calendar, attention, relationships, and decisions.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing freedom to retirement fantasies or luxury leisure.

opening with a moral lesson about discipline
